comments.body:
## RCA — confirmed defect (Phase 1)

**Proven root cause.** The completion verifier's deterministic **prefetch** reads
verdict-bearing working-tree file bodies from the LIVE checkout (B), not the `--ref`-pinned
code snapshot (A). `completion_prefetch.assemble_prefetch(spec, repo_root=...)` is called by
`gate_ops.completion_precheck` with `repo_root=ctx.repo_root` — which is the TICKET-store /
live checkout root (the workflow threads the live root; the pinned code snapshot is a SEPARATE
materialized tree, exposed via `current_code_root()` / `cfg.repo_path`). `assemble_prefetch`
then does its working-tree reads through that same `repo_root`:
`_read_body(repo_root, path)` (`src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_prefetch.py:329-334`) and
`_discover_test_globs(repo_root, …)` (`:338-357`). It never consults `current_code_root()` /
`resolve_code_root`, so even inside an attested gate that correctly pinned A, the prefetched
`<prefetched_file_contents>` block contains B's bytes, and those bytes are injected into the
verifier's context as evidence it judges criteria against.

Every OTHER verdict-bearing code read is correctly pinned to A: the agentic verifier's
read_file/search_files resolve via `cfg.repo_path` / `use_code_root(handle.path)`
(`gate_source.gate_read_root`); `completion_reconcile` resolves citations via `cfg.repo_path`
(`gate_ops.py:290`); `verified_at_sha` and the completion signature bind to `handle.sha` = A
(`gate_source.annotate_result`). The transition-close drift guard compares the live HEAD/ref
against the verified sha — the contract-permitted, one-way "reject/retry stale work" live
comparison, not verdict evidence. So the account is a SINGLE leak: the prefetch working-tree
reads.

`referencing_commit_diffs` reads via `git -C <repo_root> show <sha>`; a commit diff is
immutable content addressed by an immutable SHA (identical from any clone that holds the
object) and the materialized snapshot has no `.git`, so that read is intentionally left on the
live repo's object store — it is not live-mutable checkout evidence.

**Proof (runtime, dynamic hypothesis).** Divergent A/B experiment: a live checkout dir B and a
separate pinned snapshot dir A each hold `target.py` with deliberately different content;
ticket `file_impact` declares `target.py` (only the ticket-state boundary stubbed). Entering
the REAL `gate_source.gate_read_root(SnapshotHandle(path=A, source=attested))` context (which
activates `use_code_root(A)` — verified: `current_code_root()` == A inside the block) and then
calling the REAL `assemble_prefetch(spec, repo_root=B)` exactly as `completion_precheck` does,
the emitted `<prefetched_file_contents>` contained `LIVE_B_CONTENT` and did NOT contain
`PINNED_A_CONTENT`. Predicted-if-true (reads B) observed; predicted-if-false (reads A) ruled
out. The mechanism fires at runtime.

**Defect origin (caused_by).** `a9dd-bbc7-f549-4fc2` — "prefetch file_impact into verifier
context", landed as commit `6d343d13626c`. This is the commit that added `completion_prefetch`
and wired it into `completion_precheck`, reading code through the threaded `repo_root` without
resolving the pinned code root. The pinned-code-root primitives (`resolve_code_root`,
`use_code_root`) already existed at a9dd's parent (verified: both present at `6d343d13626c^`),
so this is an unmet-obligation / incomplete-implementation miss in a9dd, not a regression of
older code — attribution is to a9dd's introducing commit, and `git blame` on the implicated
lines names a9dd directly (not a carrier). Close class: `plan_defect`.

**Disposition.** Confirmed `defect` (violates the pinned-`--ref` code-read contract stated in
this ticket and established by `sedate-villainous-teledu` / `resolve_code_root`'s documented
purpose). Fix is a localized re-root of the prefetch's working-tree reads to the pinned code
root; RED regression test + fix to follow under RED→GREEN.

comments.body:
## /rebar-debug reporting back — root cause proven, fix pushed (Gerrit 2323)

**Problem.** On a `--ref A`-targeted completion verification the verifier's
prefetch injected LIVE-checkout (B) file bodies into its verdict-bearing
`<prefetched_file_contents>` evidence, instead of the `--ref`-pinned code
snapshot (A). This violates the ticket's public contract: checks that judge
the implementation must use the `--ref` code revision; live-checkout content
must never become verdict evidence for a `--ref`-targeted run.

**Proven root cause.** `gate_ops.completion_precheck` calls
`completion_prefetch.assemble_prefetch(spec, repo_root=ctx.repo_root)`, where
`ctx.repo_root` is the LIVE checkout / ticket-store root the workflow threads
through — deliberately (ticket reads need it). But `assemble_prefetch` also
performed the *verdict-bearing WORKING-TREE reads* — `_read_body(repo_root, …)`
for declared `file_impact` bodies and `_discover_test_globs(repo_root, …)` —
from that same live `repo_root`, never consulting the pinned snapshot the
attested gate had activated via `use_code_root(handle.path)` /
`current_code_root()`. Every OTHER verdict-bearing read already pins A (agent
tools via `cfg.repo_path`/`use_code_root`; reconcile citations at
`gate_ops.py:290`; the signed `verified_at_sha` = `handle.sha`). Prefetch was
the sole leak.

**Proof (runtime).** Built a real attested gate context
(`gate_source.gate_read_root(SnapshotHandle(path=snap_A, sha=…,
source=SOURCE_ATTESTED))`) with a divergent A/B fixture (live B and pinned A
declare the same path with different bytes). Asserted the gate really pinned A
(`current_code_root() == snap_A`), then called the real
`assemble_prefetch(repo_root=live_B)`. Before fix: section contained
`LIVE_B_CONTENT`, not `PINNED_A_CONTENT` → leak confirmed. After fix: section
contains A, not B.

**Defect origin + caused_by.** Introduced by commit `6d343d13626c` (ticket
`a9dd-bbc7-f549-4fc2`, "prefetch file_impact into verifier context"). At that
commit's parent, `resolve_code_root`/`use_code_root` already existed, so this
is an unmet-obligation / incomplete-implementation (the new prefetch reads did
not honor the pinned-code-root contract that pre-existed them), not a carrier
regression. Recorded `caused_by → a9dd-bbc7-f549-4fc2`.

**Test path.**
`tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_prefetch_pinned_root_831f.py` — held-out
oracle driving the real `gate_read_root` + `assemble_prefetch` path with the
A/B fixture; asserts the prefetch section carries A, not B, under an attested
gate (RED before fix), plus a negative control asserting local/no-gate mode
still reads the passed `repo_root`. Offline: stubs only `_reads.show_ticket`.

**Fix.** `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_prefetch.py`: re-root ONLY the
working-tree reads to
`code_root = resolve_code_root(allow_checkout_fallback=False) or repo_root`
(yields the active snapshot A under a gate; falls back to `repo_root` in
local/no-gate mode, preserving behavior). `_discover_test_globs` and
`_read_body` now use `code_root`. Ticket reads (`show_ticket`,
`_subtree_impacts`) and immutable-by-SHA `referencing_commit_diffs` stay on
`repo_root` (the materialized snapshot has no `.git`; a commit diff is fixed by
its SHA, not live state). Import goes through `rebar.llm.config` per the
gate_context seam contract.

**Scope & safety.** Localized, behavior-preserving. Local/no-gate mode
unchanged (no active snapshot → `resolve_code_root` returns None → falls back
to `repo_root`). No CLI/schema/API/output-contract surface change. Sole
real-content caller is `gate_ops.completion_precheck`; `operations.assemble_context`
passes `prefetch=None` on all code-review paths (sibling-parity checked).
`make lint` (ruff + complexity + module-size) and `make typecheck` pass; the
existing 26-test prefetch suite + gate_context seam suite pass.

**Siblings swept.** (1) Other verdict-bearing code reads passing live
`repo_root` where the snapshot should win — reconcile citations and agent
tools already pin A (no leak). (2) Parity: the code-review gate prefetch path —
`assemble_context(prefetch=None)` on every review caller, so no analogous leak.
No sibling tickets required.

**Residual risk.** Low. The only behavioral change is under an active attested
snapshot gate, which is exactly the `--ref` path the contract governs. Immutable
commit-diff reads intentionally remain on the live object store (content-addressed
by SHA).

**Replication.** The held-out test is the end-to-end reproduction (real gate +
real prefetch, divergent A/B). Mutation-checked (re-seeding the exact defect
turns the test RED).

**Disposition:** FIX pushed to Gerrit change 2323
(https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2323). Awaiting `LLM-Review +1`
and `Verified +1`; will Submit and close `--class=plan_defect
--caused-by=a9dd-bbc7-f549-4fc2` once both are green and merged.

DISPOSITION: LANDED.

compiled_state.description:
## Suspected defect
A source-path audit at code revision d49466b5e960 suggests that one completion operation may combine code evidence read from the immutable tree selected by `--ref` with prefetch, deterministic checks, or later signing inputs rooted at the live checkout. This is a hypothesis from control-flow inspection, not a demonstrated failure. It MUST be verified experimentally before any production change.

The public contract is that checks which judge the implementation are based on the code revision supplied by `--ref`. Comparisons against live state can be valid for drift detection, ancestry, optimistic concurrency, or publication safety, but live checkout content must not become verdict evidence for a `--ref`-targeted run.

## Mandatory reproduction before remediation
1. Build a disposable Git fixture with revisions A and B whose source, referencing commit evidence, and a prefetched file deliberately disagree. Keep the live checkout at B and invoke the real completion path with `--ref A`.
2. Instrument or spy on every code-root/ref input used by context assembly, completion prefetch, deterministic commit/file checks, verifier tools, drift checks, and completion-signature material. Record the resolved OID and classify each read as verdict evidence, ticket-state evidence, or an intentional live-state comparison.
3. Prove whether all verdict-bearing code reads resolve to A. If they do, record the falsification and close this bug without a speculative refactor. If any verdict-bearing read resolves to B, preserve the failing experiment as the regression test before changing code.

## Remediation constraints if reproduced
- Thread one explicit pinned-code handle/OID through every verdict-bearing path; do not let a generic `repo_root` silently select live code.
- Keep intentional live comparisons explicit and one-way: they may reject/retry stale work, but may not contribute evidence that makes a criterion pass or fail.
- Bind `verified_at_sha` and the completion signature to the same A selected by `--ref`.
- Cover a moving branch name as well as a concrete SHA, resolving the name once at operation start.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A deterministic divergent-A/B experiment proves or falsifies the suspected mixed-root behavior through the real completion orchestration path. (Held-out oracle `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_prefetch_pinned_root_831f.py` drives the REAL `gate_source.gate_read_root(attested A)` + `assemble_prefetch(repo_root=live B)` path; Phase-1 runtime experiment reproduced the same via the real orchestration. PROVED (not falsified): prefetch read B.)
- [x] The evidence records the resolved OID and purpose of every code read used by prefetch, deterministic checks, agent file tools, drift comparison, and signing. (RCA comment classifies each: prefetch working-tree reads -> now the pinned snapshot A (was live B, the leak); reconcile citations -> A via `cfg.repo_path` at `gate_ops.py:290`; agent read_file/search_files -> A via `use_code_root(handle.path)`/`cfg.repo_path`; `referencing_commit_diffs` -> immutable-by-SHA object read (not live checkout evidence); drift guard -> one-way live comparison, not verdict evidence; signing -> `verified_at_sha`=`handle.sha`=A.)
- [x] If reproduced, a regression test fails before the fix when live=B and `--ref=A`, then passes only when every verdict-bearing check uses A. (Same held-out test: verified RED at buggy HEAD (prefetch carried `LIVE_B_CONTENT`), GREEN after the re-root fix; mutation-checked -- re-seeding the exact defect on both `_read_body` and `_discover_test_globs` re-roots turns it RED.)
- [x] Intentional live-state comparisons are named and tested to fail closed or retry without becoming verdict evidence. (The transition-close drift/stale guard is the sole intentional live comparison: it compares live HEAD/ref against the pinned `verified_at_sha` to reject/retry stale work and never feeds verdict evidence -- covered by `tests/unit/test_attested_close_guard.py`. The fix does not touch it; audit confirmed it stays one-way.)
- [x] The emitted `verified_at_sha` and signed completion manifest equal A. (`gate_source.annotate_result` binds `result["verified_at_sha"] = handle.sha` (=A) and marks the run `signable` only when attested + pinned SHA -- `src/rebar/llm/gate_source.py:232`; provenance covered by `tests/unit/test_code_review_provenance.py`. Already correct; audit-confirmed, unchanged by this fix.)
- [x] If the experiment falsifies the hypothesis, no production behavior is changed and the ticket closes with the falsifying evidence. (Inapplicable branch: the experiment CONFIRMED the hypothesis rather than falsifying it, so the "no production change" path was not taken; the localized re-root fix landed instead. Recorded for completeness.)
compiled_state.title: --ref-targeted completion may mix pinned code with live-checkout inputs
